phase_a: Gloomy documentation training split and existing Gloomy checkpoint
phase_b: Evenly spaced subset of Ocara training documents; one resumed epoch, no QA supervision
replay_unit: source document; the CLI tokenizes each replayed line into overlapping training windows

strategies.reservoir: N uniformly sampled phase-A documents, fixed seed
strategies.prioritized_loss: N documents sampled with replacement proportional to phase-A per-document cross-entropy, without correction
strategies.prioritized_corrected: Same prioritized samples with beta=1 document-level importance weight 1/(N*p_i); each document contributes its token-average loss and the denominator is independent of importance weights

limitations: single training seed, phase order and replay capacity; exploratory comparison, not a general ranking
QA metrics are reported but phase-B adaptation trains next-token text only
training updates differ because replay documents produce different numbers of token windows; a fixed-update comparison remains to be run
